name: mud-editor
description: Validation and map editing for MUD world data folders

mud.serverPath.markdownDescription: The `mud` binary used to run `mud lsp`. A bare name is looked up on `PATH`. A relative path such as `./mud` is resolved against the workspace folder.

mud.dataFolder.markdownDescription: The world's data folder, relative to the workspace folder.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build -- --minify && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --allow-missing-repository
